snippet.title: [KEWR] - Newark Liberty Intl. Airport by FeelThere for Tower! Simulator
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/kewr-tower-simulator/

About:

EWR is located only 14 miles from Manhattan, serving a critical role for the New York/Newark metropolitan area.

The airport spans over 2,000 acres and has multiple runways, making it a crucial global air travel gateway. EWR has three terminals: Terminal A, Terminal B, and Terminal C.

The largest airport system in the U.S. is made up of the trio of La Guardia Airport (included in the base game), John F. Kennedy Airport (available also for Tower Simulator), and Newark Airport.

- 4L/22R: 11,000 by 150 feet (3,353 m × 46 m), asphalt/concrete, grooved
- 4R/22L: 9,999 by 150 feet (3,048 m × 46 m), asphalt, grooved
- 11/29: 6,725 by 150 feet (2,050 m × 46 m), asphalt, grooved

The airport has more than 12 miles of 75-foot-wide taxiways. Three of the new taxiways allow multiple planes to stage for departure at the end of the runway, reducing takeoff delays, while the other new taxiway will allow arriving planes to exit the runway faster and get to the gates quicker.

Features:

- Realistic modeling with over 100 custom modelled buildings.
- Detailed ground polygon model including taxiway bridges
- Updated selection of Radar screens.
- Modelled Taxi signs.
- Updated taxi light models that follow the curve of the lines and wigwag lights placed at runway entrances.
- Dynamic runway approach lighting with runway sequenced flashers.
- Beautiful background cityscape from OSM (open street maps).
